chunks.title: Akbank (Akbank) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Akbank is a Turkish Commercial Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Active COP31 Green Zone exhibitor partnering with GEFF Türkiye, KGF, Migros & TARİŞ on sustainable agriculture, circular industry & women's green access. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: TRY 2.5 trillion sustainable finance target through 2030; COP31 programs spanning GEFF Türkiye, KGF-backed sustainable agri & circular industrial loans. Source verification: https://basakgazetesi.com/haber/akbank-cop31-icin-kapsamli-iklim-finansmani-ve-donusum-programini-acikladi-897587.

chunks.title: Akbank Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Akbank provides the following climate financing instruments: GEFF Türkiye Green Loan, KGF-Backed Sustainability Loan, Corporate Transition Loan, Sustainable Agriculture Credit, Green Leasing. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 50,000 to USD 120,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: SME, Large Corporate, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup.

chunks.title: Akbank Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Akbank: SME Green Transition, Sustainable Agriculture & Water, Circular Economy & Zero Waste, Renewable Energy, Industrial Decarbonization, Women-Led Green Enterprise. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Akbank Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Akbank's application form: Turkish VKN registration & credit eligibility; GEFF Türkiye Technology Selector or Akbank Sustainable Finance Framework match; KGF eligibility check (for KGF-backed SME green lines); Carbon/water savings estimate & environmental compliance. Explicit exclusion rules: Thermal coal mining/generation; Non-compliant industrial waste. Official application portal: https://www.akbank.com/en-us/sustainability.

chunks.title: Akbank Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: Akbank uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
